intro.label: ✦ Our Work
intro.heading: 150+ Projects Delivered Across 12+ Industries
intro.description: From early-stage startups to enterprise brands, we've helped businesses build digital products that grow users, increase revenue, and create lasting impact. Every case study here reflects a real partnership, a real challenge, and a real result.

caseStudies.title: Next-Gen E-Commerce Platform for 2M+ Users
caseStudies.description: Rebuilt a legacy e-commerce platform from scratch — delivering 3× faster load times, a modern UI, and a 45% jump in conversions.
caseStudies.challenge: Their legacy platform was crashing under load, had poor mobile UX, and was losing 60% of users at checkout.
caseStudies.solution: We rebuilt the entire stack using React + Node microservices, implemented lazy loading, and redesigned the checkout flow.

caseStudies.title: Secure Mobile Banking App with Real-Time Transactions
caseStudies.description: A fully compliant digital banking app with biometric auth, real-time payments, and AI-powered fraud detection for 500K+ users.
caseStudies.challenge: Building a secure, RBI-compliant banking app with sub-second transaction speeds and fraud protection from day one.
caseStudies.solution: Flutter for cross-platform delivery, Python ML models for fraud detection, and a microservices backend on GCP.

caseStudies.title: AI-Powered Patient Management & Diagnostics Platform
caseStudies.description: An intelligent healthcare dashboard for 300+ clinics enabling early diagnosis, appointment scheduling, and EHR management.
caseStudies.challenge: Clinics were using paper records and manual scheduling — causing delays, errors, and poor patient outcomes.
caseStudies.solution: Built a unified EHR + scheduling platform with TensorFlow-powered diagnostic assistance for doctors.

caseStudies.title: Smart Real Estate Discovery Platform with AI Matching
caseStudies.description: An intelligent property discovery engine with virtual tours, AI recommendations, and mortgage calculators for buyers.
caseStudies.challenge: Users were bouncing within seconds due to slow search, irrelevant results, and no personalization.
caseStudies.solution: Built AI-powered matching, lazy-loaded virtual tours, and a Redis-cached search engine delivering results in <200ms.

caseStudies.title: ML-Driven Logistics Optimization Saving $2M Annually
caseStudies.description: A route optimization engine using machine learning that reduced delivery costs by 38% and improved on-time rates to 97%.
caseStudies.challenge: Manual route planning was costing the client $2M+ per year in fuel, overtime, and missed deliveries.
caseStudies.solution: Developed a real-time ML optimization engine that recalculates 10,000+ routes per minute based on live traffic data.

caseStudies.title: Gamified EdTech App with 800K+ Active Learners
caseStudies.description: A cross-platform learning app with live sessions, AI tutoring, gamification, and offline-first architecture.
caseStudies.challenge: Low engagement and high drop-off after the first week — learners were losing motivation without structure.
caseStudies.solution: Introduced AI-personalized learning paths, streak gamification, and offline mode for users with low connectivity.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: Project timelines vary by scope. A mobile app typically takes 4–8 months, while complex enterprise platforms can take 10–14 months. We provide a detailed timeline during the discovery phase.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups or only enterprises?
faqs.answer: We work with both. We've helped early-stage startups launch their MVP in 3 months and helped enterprise clients rebuild legacy systems at scale.

faqs.question: What industries do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: FinTech, HealthTech, E-Commerce, EdTech, Real Estate, and Logistics are our core verticals — but we've successfully delivered projects across 12+ industries.

faqs.question: Can I see more detailed case study documentation?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. For NDA-protected projects we share detailed decks on request. Contact us and we'll arrange a walkthrough call with the project lead.

faqs.question: What happens after the project is delivered?
faqs.answer: We offer 3–6 months of post-launch support, performance monitoring, and iterative improvement cycles as part of all our engagement packages.
